dog.description_text: Mika is a beautiful kitten with striking markings that make her truly stand out, from the gorgeous pattern across her back to the dark stripe running along her spine. Still a petite kitten, she's full of curiosity and always ready to turn the simplest toy into an adventure. Whether it's feather wands, jingly balls, or anything she can chase and pounce on, Mika is happiest when she's playing. Her playful spirit is balanced by an affectionate side, too. Give her a little attention, and she'll happily let you scoop her up before settling comfortably into your lap for some quiet cuddles. Mika came to ARF through our Operation Cat program and is now looking for the loving family she's been waiting for. If you're searching for a kitten who will keep you smiling with her playful antics and melt your heart when it's time to relax, Mika is ready to make your home her own.
